## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amnéville, France. It starts at 5 Rue du Tigre.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Lovers of marine life will be able to share in over 30 years of passion at the Amnéville Aquarium! Opened in 1989, the aquarium has seen more two million visitors pass through its doors and it continues to grow.
>
> Inside you’ll find 11 distinct areas, including a shark aquarium and a zen garden. All aspects of the life aquatic are covered, from Australia’s Great Barrier Reef to the Indian Ocean and the waters around Hawaii’s islands. Keep an eye out for shark species, seahorses, jellyfish, piranhas, and many more inside!
>
> There's plenty for kids to enjoy too, from the touch tank to a play area. It's a great day for the whole family!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.88. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 150 ratings and 60 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
